lines: Tap anywhere on the screen to continue the conversation.

I'll show you how to play each game, one by one.
Follow along!

round1: The first game is card matching!

Flip two cards at a time.
Find the same picture to make a pair.

I'll show you the cards for a moment first.
Remember them well!
round2: Round 1 clear! That was easy, right?

I'll show them to you first again,
so focus and remember!
retry:
I'll give you one more chance.
Good luck this time~..

intro: The second game is riding a board all the way to the finish!

Tap the screen to jump!
Tap twice quickly to do a flip, wheee~!
Don't fall into the holes. Make it to the end!
retry:
Focus, focus!!!
I'll give you one more chance

intro: The last game is dressing up Yoojung!

Pick a top, bottom, and shoes from the closet
to make a cute and stylish Yoojung!
ending:
I love today's outfit!
Shall we take a photo together?
